last_episode_to_air.name: Episode 31
last_episode_to_air.overview:
San Cai arrived in Spain. In the cab, she suddenly reminisced her past when she saw the church where she waited for Dao Ming Si before he met an accident. The next day, she strolled on the streets of Barcelona all by herself. She stood in front of a fountain and thought about the legend of the spring water while thinking of Dao Ming Si.

In a bullfight event, San Cai was recording the crowded scenes with her video camera when she was accidentally pushed by the excited crowd. She struggled to get up until a hand wearing a meteor star ring stretches out to her. She held her hand (also wearing her own meteor star ring) onto his palm. Finally, the two rings were reunited together, as the two hands, each wearing one ring, are clasped together tightly. She looked up and she was surprised to see Dao Ming Si.

From that moment, Shan Cai and Dao Ming Si were reunited.

name: Meteor Garden
overview: Shan Cai, whose parents are far from wealthy, attends Ying De University, the private school established exclusively for rich students. Besides being looked down by rich classmates, she has angered the leader of F4, Dao Ming Si.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: Shan Cai, a working-class girl, enters the elite Ying De University and clashes with Daoming Si, the arrogant leader of F4. Unfazed by his power, she stands up to him, drawing both his interest and his torment. Meanwhile, she finds comfort in the kind-hearted Huaze Lei. As Daoming Si’s feelings deepen, his ruthless mother steps in to keep them apart. Can love bridge their worlds despite class differences and obstacles?

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: After graduating, F4 travels to Spain, giving Daoming Si and Shan Cai time together. Following Huaze Lei’s advice, Daoming Si plans a romantic proposal in a legendary church and buys a ring Shan Cai loves. However, before he can propose, a car accident leaves him with amnesia, and he is taken in by Ye Sha, complicating his relationship with Shan Cai.
